independent_analytical_power.methodology: Asymptotic Gaussian approximation and finite-sample Bartlett kernel variance scaling
independent_analytical_power.key_finding: At N=30, rho=0.20, std=50bps, eff=15bps, asymptotic power is exactly 11.55%, and finite-sample variance adjusted power is 11.83%. At the null boundary (eff=10bps), asymptotic power is mathematically 5.00%.
